segments.sn35.102:1.2: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.102:1.6: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.102:1.9: Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
segments.sn35.102:1.12: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.102:1.15: So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati … pe …
segments.sn35.102:1.16: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na tumhākaṃ.
segments.sn35.102:1.18: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.102:1.19: Yampi, bhikkhave, na tumhākaṃ, taṃ pajahatha.
segments.sn35.102:1.20: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissatī”ti.

lines: 101-102. Aṭṭhamaṃ upamāya parivāretvā kathite bujjhanakānaṃ, navamaṃ suddhikavaseneva bujjhanakānaṃ ajjhāsayavasena vuttaṃ.
Attho pana ubhayatthāpi khandhiyavagge vuttanayeneva veditabbo.
